new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent false
new.Description: Mark attendance for a valid employeeId with absent status false
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent false
new.Expected Result: AttendanceModel object is returned with employeeId 1 and absent false

new.Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
new.Description: Mark attendance for a valid employeeId with absent status true
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent true
new.Expected Result: AttendanceModel object is returned with employeeId 1 and absent true

new.Title: Mark attendance with null absent
new.Description: Send request with null absent to check validation
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId 1 and absent null
new.Expected Result: Response with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with null employeeId
new.Description: Send request with null employeeId to check validation
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing absent true and employeeId null
new.Expected Result: Response with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark attendance with date provided
new.Description: Mark attendance with employeeId, absent and specific date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId, absent and date
new.Expected Result: AttendanceModel object is returned with employeeId 1, absent true and date 2024-06-01

new.Title: Mark attendance with null body
new.Description: Send request with null body to check validation
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
new.Expected Result: Response with message 'employeeId and absent required'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
new.Description: Send an empty list to mark batch attendance endpoint
Test Steps: Prepare an empty list
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as body
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
new.Description: Send a valid list of attendance records to mark batch attendance
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service is running and employees exist
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs with valid employeeId, absent, and optional date
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status and body
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 2, presentCount equal to 1, absentCount equal to 1, invalidEntries empty, and savedRecords with attendance details

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
new.Description: Send a list with some attendance DTOs missing required fields
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service is running and employees exist
Test Steps: Prepare a list with some valid and some invalid attendance DTOs
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status and body for saved and invalid entries
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 2, presentCount and absentCount correct, invalidEntries contains employeeId 2 only

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
new.Description: Send null as payload to mark batch attendance endpoint
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status and error message
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'payload is empty'

new.Title: Mark batch attendance with missing date field
new.Description: Send attendance DTOs without date field to verify default date usage
new.Pre-Conditions: Attendance service is running and employees exist
Test Steps: Prepare a list of attendance DTOs without date field
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status and that attendance is marked with current date
new.Expected Result: Response contains savedCount equal to 2, presentCount and absentCount correct, savedRecords have current date

new.Title: Get all employees successfully
new.Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns a list of all employees
new.Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Receive response
new.Expected Result: Response contains a list of employee objects

new.Title: Get employee by valid id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
new.Expected Result: Response contains employee details with the given id

new.Title: Get employee by non-existing id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 404 when employee with given id does not exist
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'employee not found'

new.Title: Get employee with null id
new.Description: Verify that the API returns 400 when id path parameter is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
new.Expected Result: Response contains message 'id is required'

new.Title: Create employee with valid data
new.Description: Verify creating an employee with valid name, role, and id
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON containing id, name, and role
new.Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee data in response body and Location header set

new.Title: Create employee with missing name
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing name
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with missing role
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing role
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with empty name
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON where name is empty string
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with empty role
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON where role is empty string
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with missing id
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when id is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing id
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Create employee with null body
new.Description: Verify creating an employee fails when request body is null
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
new.Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

new.Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
new.Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns status 200
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include valid JSON body with fields to update
new.Expected Result: Response body contains updated employee with new values

new.Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
new.Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns status 200
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include JSON body with only some fields (e.g. only name)
new.Expected Result: Response body contains employee with updated name and other fields unchanged

new.Title: Update employee with non-existing id
new.Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with message 'employee not found'
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with given id
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Include valid JSON body
new.Expected Result: Response body contains message 'employee not found'

new.Title: Update employee with null request body
new.Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns bad request with message 'request body is required'
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Do not include request body or send null body
new.Expected Result: Response body contains message 'request body is required'

new.Title: Update employee with null id
new.Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns bad request with message 'id is required'
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Include valid JSON body
new.Expected Result: Response body contains message 'id is required'

new.Title: Delete employee with valid id
new.Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 status
new.Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
new.Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted

new.Title: Delete employee with null id
new.Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 status with message
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
new.Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"id is required"}

new.Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
new.Description: Verify deleting an employee with id not present returns 404 status with message
new.Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
new.Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with body {"message":"employee not found"}
